title: First principles: What it takes to be a great product manager in the AI era | Sherif Mansour
summary: Sherif Mansour shares first principles on what it takes to be a great PM in the AI era
detailed: Sherif Mansour serves as the Head of AI and Product Craft at Atlassian, bringing 17 years of experience building and scaling enterprise products.
He joined Atlassian as its first product manager on Confluence, later becoming its first Distinguished Product Manager.
In his current role, he oversees both product management craft across the company and Atlassian's AI product strategy.
sentences: Sherif Mansour is Head of AI and Product Craft at Atlassian (the company behind Jira and Confluence), where he has spent 17 years building and scaling some of the most successful enterprise products in history.

He joined Atlassian as its first PM on Confluence, eventually becoming its first Distinguished PM, and now leads both the craft of product management across the company and Atlassian’s AI product strategy.
